set.name: Distance from a point to a line

criteria: 能反过来判断点到圆心的距离范围

set.name: Position of a Point Relative to a Circle

criteria: 能说明垂直的定义和符号
能用三角尺过一点作垂线
set.description: 两条直线相交成直角叫互相垂直，其中一条叫另一条的垂线，掌握过一点作已知直线垂线的方法及其唯一性。
set.name: Perpendicular lines

set.reason: The distance in question is the length of the perpendicular from the point, so perpendicularity identifies which segment is measured.
The threshold distance is the shortest perpendicular center-to-line segment.

The target explicitly connects line position with intersection count and center-distance thresholds. The inside/on/outside meaning for the line points is used in that explanation, without requiring every earlier exercise.
set.scope: Explaining line-circle intersection counts using inside, on and outside points

set.reason: The tangent-radius property requires knowing what a tangent line is.
A special trigonometric value is a value of the corresponding side ratio.
The distance is the length of a perpendicular point-to-line segment.
